title: The Keel-seam Set
summary: Something to carry out of the Carina, keel shards worked into a mask and a pair of boots to round out the plate.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now work keel shards and chalk marrow into a mask, and keel shards and drag cord into boots, to go with the keel plate.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking chalk marrow and drag cord, for anyone who would rather buy than pull them off whatever the Carina left standing.

items.name: Keel-seam mask
items.examine: Keel shards ground thin and fitted over the mouth. Breathes about as well as you would expect.

items.name: Keel-seam boots
items.examine: Keel shards riveted to the sole, drag cord wound round the ankle until it stops moving.
